name: Fruit Punch
source:
“Fruit Punch” is a late night TV program where idol girls cosplay and report from various places. Considered the airing time some spicy scenes are possible, but no one expected girls to be deceived and sexually assaulted for real.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
